title: Data privacy concerns could hold patients back from using AI
summary: Although artificial intelligence has quickly become integrated into our daily lives, Americans say they’re becoming increasingly concerned about their health data, according to a new survey.

title: CommonSpirit Health grows operating revenue 8.5% to $42.4B in FY2026
summary: The 156-hospital nonprofit chopped its operating losses down by $257 million, notwithstanding the multibillion-dollar impact of its revenue cycle management breakup with Tenet Health.

title: HRSA names 10 drugmakers for revised 340B rebate pilot ahead of 2027 launch
summary: The list of approved participants and drugs is larger than the controversial pilot's first attempted launch. It comes the same day that CMS launched a soon-to-be-mandatory data repository for Part D 340B claim submissions.

title: AKASA debuts autonomous AI platform for inpatient medical coding and clinical documentation
summary: Health tech company AKASA is pushing deeper into AI-powered revenue cycle workflows, launching an autonomous AI platform for inpatient medical coding and clinical documentation integrity.

title: MultiCare Health System to launch new health plan
summary: The plan will be available to Medicare-eligible patients in Washington state’s Pierce, Thurston and Spokane counties, the organization says.

title: AI Is Making a Mess of Nurses’ Schedules. They Say It’s a Safety Issue
summary: A hospital giant and radiology network turned to Palantir to streamline scheduling, but nurses and other staff say the new software is causing errors, burnout, and frustration.

title: RFK Jr.'s AI claims spark physician backlash as debate over medical AI intensifies
summary: Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the Secretary of the Department of Health and Human Services, said on Tuesday that artificial intelligence can provide patients a second opinion that is "much better informed than any doctor in the country."

title: How Optum, Owensboro Health teamed up to build a virtual nursing program
summary: Owensboro Health is teaming up with Optum Insight to pair bedside nurses with virtual nurses to free up frontline clinicians to dedicate more time to patient care.

title: Crisis responses, H.R. 1 fallout are challenging states' mental health delivery
summary: State officials spoke frankly about the challenges they face in delivering equitable mental healthcare during policy sessions at the annual Behavioral Health Tech conference last week, held in Nashville.

title: Employers increasingly tie digital health payments to outcomes, PHTI survey finds
summary: The report drew insights from 321 digital health professionals responsible for purchasing across health plans, employers and health systems.

title: When does a hospital-insurer network dispute go public?
summary: Threats to leave a commercial health coverage network are more frequent with for-profit hospitals, national payers and "Goldilocks" local markets where neither side controls too much or too little business, a recent study finds.

title: GE HealthCare hires new global chief AI officer
summary: Rodolphe Katra has joined from Medtronic to lead GE HealthCare’s efforts to connect devices, software and data.

title: Essentia, HealthPartners seek to combine amid wave of Minnesota hospital mergers
summary: Three major health system mergers have been proposed in the state over the past six months, kicking off a rush of public hearings and regulatory reviews. Essentia and HealthPartners hope to close their deal early next year.

title: Why Prime Therapeutics is betting on bridging the gaps between medical, pharmacy benefits
summary: Specialty pharmacy is a key cost driver for employers and insurers, with development in this space showing no signs of slowing down.

title: Elevance cracks down on hospital billing for off-campus care
summary: The insurer said it’s trying to restrict hospitals from charging higher rates for services at off-campus outpatient departments. Hospital groups say the reimbursement cuts could threaten access to care.
